title: Reverse Psychology
idea: Brief #33. Angle swap of our launched winner #79 (Johnny / Max, skin tags, "we lied"): benefits stated as confessions, the "lie" is the price. Swapped to bloating with castor oil + cotton belly wrap; mirror before/after shots modeled in Genjitsu from Wild Dose (191 and 227 days live). Enemy = pills, dieting, laxatives (the #1 pattern in 100 winning scripts).

script.script: We want to publicly apologize to everyone who bought Haven & Spool, because we lied.
script.visual: Initial image: woman in the full-body (optional) mirror, checking out her flat stomach, slight abs showing. First clip during the hook: woman taking her castor oil wrap off her stomach, and it looking really flat. (Use the Wild Dose references for these.)
script.on_screen_text:
H1: WE LIED (copy #79's caption style)
H2: DO NOT BUY HAVEN & SPOOL
H3: This is what we do for bloating / We're so sorry SORRY

script.script: Yes, it's true: our castor oil and belly wrap can take you from looking 6 months pregnant by 3pm to a flat-looking stomach by morning, without pills, dieting or laxatives.
script.visual: "Our castor oil and belly wrap": woman, 30s to 40s, full-length mirror selfie, side-on, flat-looking stomach with abs slightly showing, happy. "6 months pregnant by 3pm": the SAME woman, same mirror, different pose, noticeably bloated, hand on her round belly, unimpressed, afternoon light. "Flat-looking stomach by morning": back to her flat side profile, morning light, smiling. "Without pills, dieting or laxatives": a pill bottle, a sad diet meal (plain salad + calorie app) and a laxative pack pushed aside.

script.script: And yes, you can do it at home on your couch, without expensive supplements or cutting out every food you love, saving you hundreds of dollars on products that never worked.
script.visual: Woman on the couch with the wrap on, tea, blanket; woman happily eating pasta/dessert with friends; a drawer full of half-used supplements and teas.

script.script: Plus, most women just do it before bed. Roll the oil on, wrap the cotton wrap around you, thirty minutes. That's it.
script.visual: Roller gliding on the belly with an oil sheen, wrap pulled snug, phone timer at 30:00.

script.script: And yes, it comes with a 30-night money-back guarantee, even if you use it.
script.visual: Bottle + wrap with a simple "30 nights or it's free" card.

script.script: But we never thought we could make the price even lower. It turns out that was the lie.
script.visual: Hard cut to two bottles + wrap on the counter.

script.script: The truth is, right now you can get Haven & Spool buy one, get one free. We just passed 43,000 customers and wanted to pass the savings straight to you.
script.visual: Quick montage of 3 to 4 women doing the pack + a phone scrolling 5-star reviews.

script.script: It goes back to full price soon, so take advantage of it while it lasts.
script.visual: Hands holding both bottles + wrap to the lens.
script.on_screen_text: BUY 1 GET 1 FREE · 30 NIGHTS OR IT'S FREE · link below

editing_notes: Replicate our winner #79 exactly (reference link = Johnny's #79 in Hyperscale; same "we lied" structure: confessions → "that was the lie" → offer); only the angle is swapped to bloating and the product to castor oil + cotton belly wrap. Every "Yes, it's true" line gets a clip of that exact benefit, ✓ next to each. 3 ads = the same spoken hook with 3 different text hooks. MIRROR / BELLY SHOTS: model them in Genjitsu from Wild Dose (purple 'A Dose For Bloating' box), as little talking head as possible: (a) bloated + flat mirror selfies, 0:03 to 0:08 of https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?id=934264656075930 ; (b) side-on bloated belly hold (0:00) and gym 'lift the top, flat stomach' clip (0:03) of https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?id=1611821600084461 . Same woman in the bloated and flat clips; the after is a different clip, never a side-by-side. Claims: feel/look only. No gut, detox or digestion claims. OFFER: confirm the Complete Castor Oil Kit (oil + wrap) deal + landing page with the client before launch. Doc: Brief H+S, tab #33.

Voiceover: Similar to #79's reference: a female brand voice, 40s, warm, a little mischievous on "we lied", sincere on the offer. NEEDS TO HAVE CONVICTION in their voice, it's boring to listen to a dull script. They need to speak with character.

Avatar: Voiceover + B-roll, no main talking creator. B-roll women are real-looking, 40 to 55 (Genjitsu only on full-body movement shots for realism): mirror stomach checks, doing the castor oil pack on the couch, waking up, buttoning jeans. Problem aware turning product aware: bloated, tired of pills and teas.
